jobs.title: Receivership Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Griswold Receivers is seeking a full-time California Receivership Project Coordinator to support the management and oversight of 40–45 active receivership projects. This is a hybrid role that will include traveling to properties across Northern California and Nevada as needed.

In the field, you’ll conduct site inspections, coordinate with city inspectors and contractors to plan and schedule work, manage property needs such as utility setup, fencing, and security, help relocate occupants and tenants, and track overall project progress. The Project Coordinator will report to the Director, Northern California Property Management and work closely with the Operations Team to carry out day-to-day tasks for each project.

The Receivership Project Coordinator will help coordinate receivership projects from start to finish, keeping them on time, on budget, and done well. We’re looking for a proactive team player who likes working with others and takes initiative to keep projects moving. Partnering closely with the Director of Northern California Property Management, this role monitors properties, resolves issues quickly, and plays a key part in carrying out court-appointed receivership responsibilities.

 **Compensation:**

$75,000 - $85,000

 **Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple receivership projects from start to finish.
* Travel to properties throughout Northern California and Nevada to conduct inspections, monitor progress, and address issues.
* Work with city inspectors, contractors, and vendors to schedule and plan required work.
* Assist with the setup and management of property services, including utilities, fencing, and security.
* Support the relocation of occupants and tenants as needed, including identifying options and coordinating logistics.
* Monitor project timelines to keep projects on track.
* Maintain accurate records of property conditions and work performed, including photos and inspection notes.
* Prepare regular status updates and reports for the Director and Operations Team.
* Respond to urgent property issues such as damage, vandalism, or security concerns.
* Act as a point of contact for tenants and neighbors, handling concerns professionally and maintaining positive relationships.
* Work with internal teams and outside stakeholders to keep projects running efficiently.

 **Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of property management and/or construction management experience.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic project management tools.

 **About Company**

Griswold Receivers and its professionals serve exclusively as Court-appointed neutrals in a variety of legal scenarios, including health & safety receiverships, tenant habitability receiverships, post-judgment receiverships, business dispute receiverships, rents/profits receiverships, and partition actions. These matters often lead to a variety of types of rehabilitation and construction projects.

We embrace a team-centric environment and approach to support one another in our respective roles, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to take on different roles as the project may require. Our team possesses a high level of integrity and keeps a level head during high-pressure or potentially volatile situations without losing sight of the end goal.

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

Salary is dependent on experience & skillset. Benefits include an incentive plan, 401(k) (after waiting period), paid holidays, wellness reimbursement program, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Assistant Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sunny Days is seeking a full-time **Assistant Program Coordinator** for our California Early Intervention program. This fast-paced, high-volume, administrative position will support our team’s Program Coordinators with data entry, processing database reports, and a high volume of digital paperwork. It is a high impact role that helps fill the gaps so our programs can run smoothly! We are looking for a high-quality candidate with administrative experience, ideally in the field of early intervention and/or education. This is a **hybrid position**, with a preference for candidates **located within commuting distance of either Sacramento or Orange County, California**.

Sunny Days of California, Inc. provides quality, home-based, early intervention services to children birth to three years who have developmental delays and/or disabilities. Our family-centered, parent coaching approach guides families to incorporate support strategies into their daily routines, maximizing their child’s ability to participate in all aspects of their daily lives.

**What Sunny Days offers:**

* Competitive hourly rate ($22-$24/hr)
* Great benefits package - (401k,Medical, Dental and Vision)
* Positive and supportive work environment
* Hybrid position

**Duties include, but are not limited to**:

* Complete daily, time-sensitive data entry and filing
* Run reports and manage digital files
* Maintain comprehensive tracking of age outs, reports due, sessions scheduled, and other case-related deadlines
* Send welcome emails to families
* Maintain confidentiality of information regarding children and families (in accordance with HIPAA and/or State/Federal regulations)
* Assist Program Coordinators with additional tasks, as needed

This role is a key player in the coordination of services for children enrolled in our home-based, early intervention program by communicating via email, phone, and Zoom with various stakeholders. The Assistant Program Coordinator is also responsible for managing and processing a high volume of digital paperwork, tracking spreadsheets and database reports and ensuring compliance with our agency policies and contracts.

**To be effective in this role, candidates must:**

* Possess superior communication skills and have the ability to build and sustain relationships with a variety of stakeholders solely via email and phone
* Be highly organized and reliable with exceptional time management skills
* Be detail-oriented, finding enjoyment in precision and fitting the puzzle pieces together
* Have strong computer literacy and data management skills
* Be able to anticipate needs and think critically

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Minimum of two years of administrative experience
* Computer literacy and data entry experience
* Bilingual English/Spanish/Vietnamese skills a plus!

Sunny Days is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, religious creed, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or military or veteran status.

Sunny Days is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace free from discrimination in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: US Business Development Coordinator - Plugin Boutique
jobs.description:
**About Beatport**

For over 20 years, Beatport has been the global leader in DJ and club culture, pushing the boundaries of dance music to all corners of the world. Created by DJs for DJs, Beatport has always been dedicated to innovating new products and services to support evolving generations of music performers and producers.

The Beatport Group includes some of the best-known brands in DJ culture, including Beatport, Ampsuite, LabelRadar, Plugin Boutique, Beatport Live & The International Music Summit (IMS). We are consistently looking for bright, creative professionals with diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

**About Plugin Boutique**

Plugin Boutique is the world's leading online marketplace for music software, virtual instruments, and audio effects. Since its launch, Plugin Boutique has provided music producers, sound designers, and engineers with the finest tools from top developers worldwide, paired with exclusive deals, free gifts with purchase, and an industry-leading user experience. Plugin Boutique is dedicated to empowering music creators with the technology they need to shape tomorrow's sound

**Where You Come In**

The **Business Development Coordinator** supports the orchestration and execution of **Plugin Boutique’s** growth initiatives across affiliate marketing, influencer partnerships, commercial activations, global expansion, and US based events.

Working closely with the Head of Business Development & Affiliates and cross-functional teams, this role helps coordinate campaigns, maintain performance reporting, research new opportunities, support the execution of global projects and initiatives that connect Plugin Boutique with music creators and industry communities worldwide.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone interested in music, creator culture, partnerships, and digital marketing, with opportunities to develop experience across multiple business development verticals.

**Location: This role will be Hybrid based from our LA office at least 3 days per week. Applicants must be based in the USA with a valid right to work.**

**As** **Business Development Coordinator (Plugin Boutique) you will be responsible for:**

**1. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Collect, organize, and maintain campaign performance data across affiliate, influencer, partnership, event, and international market initiatives.
* Maintain reporting templates, trackers, and dashboards to monitor channel KPIs, campaign results, and performance against targets.
* Support the tracking of campaign budgets, expenses, attribution, and ROI by maintaining accurate records and compiling relevant data.

**2. Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate business development initiatives from planning through execution, maintaining project trackers, timelines, briefs, and deliverables for internal and external stakeholders.
* Work cross-functionally with Brand, Creative, Partnerships, and Product to support campaign execution.
* Follow up on outstanding tasks, approvals, assets, and deadlines, keeping internal stakeholders informed of progress.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting notes, and status updates to support team alignment and accountability.

**3. Trend Research & Industry Intelligence**

* Research emerging trends, creators, platforms, communities, brands, and partnership opportunities relevant to Plugin Boutique’s marketing and business development priorities.
* Monitor developments across music production, electronic music, creator culture, and the broader music industry.
* Track local and international music scenes, audience behavior, and emerging content formats.
* Compile research and share relevant insights, partnership opportunities, and campaign ideas.

**4. Partner Relationships & Activations**

* Support the day-to-day coordination of affiliate, influencer, education, and commercial partner relationships, including onboarding, communications, and follow-ups.
* Research and identify prospective affiliates, creators, educators, brands, developers, and community partners.
* Coordinate campaign execution across creator collaborations, co-marketing initiatives, brand activations, bundles, and promotional campaigns.
* Manage campaign logistics, including briefs, product access and gifting, trackable links, creative assets, internal approvals, content deadlines, and partner deliverables.
* Maintain accurate partner records, campaign trackers, and documentation to support relationship management and ensure agreed deliverables are completed on schedule.

The Operations Coordinator is a full-time member of the Operations Support Team. Based in downtown Los Angeles, CA and reporting to the Manager-Operations Support, you will provide administrative support to our tax practice: processing and e-filing returns, billing clients (including monthly recurring accounting and tax engagements), coordinating client documents and communication, and handling internal special projects. This role suits someone organized and dependable who knows the tax season workflow and can work independently, both in the office and remotely.

**Responsibilities**

▪Assemble, finalize, and deliver completed tax returns to clients through the client portal, email, or mail.

▪Prepare and send e-file authorizations (such as Forms 8879 and 8878) and engagement letters, and follow up until they are signed.

▪E-file returns and extensions once authorized, monitor acceptances, and work with preparers to resolve rejections.

▪Track filing deadlines, extensions, and estimated payment vouchers, and keep return status current in Financial Cents.

▪Send tax organizers, engagement letters, and document request lists, and track receipt of client documents.

**Client Billing and Collections**

▪Run monthly recurring billing for clients on recurring engagements, such as accounting, bookkeeping, and tax preparation, and confirm each invoice matches the client’s engagement terms before it goes out.

▪Update recurring invoices when clients add, change, or end services, and flag pricing questions to the Manager - Operations Support.

▪Prepare and send one-time invoices when returns and projects are completed, following engagement terms and pricing.

▪Review unbilled time and draft invoices with tax managers before release.

▪Apply payments, follow up on outstanding balances using the AR aging report, and record collection notes in Financial Cents.

**Internal Special Projects**

▪Lead or support internal projects assigned by the Manager-Operations Support, such as process documentation, client data cleanup, and workflow improvements.

▪Help newly joined offices adopt LedgerWay tax workflows,templates, and software.

▪Prepare tracking lists and status reports for tax season, extensions, and other initiatives.

▪Take on other administrative and operational tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**▪**High school diploma or equivalent, at minimum.

▪One to two years of administrative or client service experience, ideally at an accounting or tax firm.

▪A client-first attitude: friendly, responsive, and professional in every call and email.

▪A working understanding of the tax season workflow, including efile authorizations and filing deadlines.

▪Comfortable handling client billing and payment follow-up with tact and clear communication.

▪Organized and dependable, so client requests and deadlines never slip through the cracks.

▪Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Teams) and trusted with confidential client information.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative (CA)
jobs.description:
**About Yumwoof**

Yumwoof is a fast-growing premium dog food brand focused on creating better, healthier food for dogs. As we continue expanding our retail and distribution footprint across the U.S., we are looking for a motivated and passionate **Field Sales Representative** (**based in California, Nevada, Washington, Oregon, and/or Florida**) to help us build strong relationships with our retail partners and support our growth in the market.

**About the Role**

As a Field Sales Representative at Yumwoof, you will be the face of our brand for independent pet retailers in your territory.

Your primary responsibility will be to support our retail partners, work closely with our distributors and their sales teams, and make sure Yumwoof is represented successfully at store level.

This is a hands-on field role with **approximately 75% travel within your assigned territory.** You will spend significant time visiting stores, building relationships with store owners and managers, training retail teams, supporting distributor sales representatives, and identifying opportunities to grow Yumwoof within existing and new independent accounts. You will also actively prospect for new business through **in-person visits to independent pet retailers** within your territory.

**This role can also be a great fit for someone currently working in pet retail.** If you are an experienced store manager, assistant manager, department lead, or retail team member who knows the pet industry, understands how independent pet stores operate, and is ready to take the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We care about your ability to connect with people, understand retailers, learn quickly, take ownership, and represent Yumwoof with enthusiasm.

**What You'll Do**

* Visit independent pet retailers throughout your assigned territory
* Build strong relationships with store owners, managers, and retail teams
* Educate and train store employees on Yumwoof products, ingredients, benefits, and key selling points
* Conduct product trainings, store visits, and in-store demonstrations
* Work closely with our distribution partners and participate in distributor sales rep ride-alongs
* Support distributor sales representatives with product knowledge and retailer conversations
* Help introduce Yumwoof to new retail locations within the territory
* Increase product visibility, placement, and assortment within existing accounts
* Ensure Yumwoof products, displays, and marketing materials are properly represented in stores
* Identify stores that need additional support, training, samples, or marketing materials
* Help drive reorders and improve sales performance within existing retail accounts
* Gather feedback from retailers and communicate market insights back to the Yumwoof team
* Track store visits, trainings, opportunities, and follow-up actions
* Attend distributor events, trade shows, retailer events, and other industry events as needed
* Collaborate closely with Yumwoof's Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams

**Who We're Looking For**

We are open to candidates coming from different backgrounds.

You could already be working in field sales or territory management, or you could be an experienced pet retail professional who is ready to move from working inside one store to building relationships with retailers across an entire territory.

You may be a great fit if you have:

* Experience in pet retail, field sales, territory sales, account management, or another customer-facing role
* Experience as a pet store manager, assistant manager, department lead, or experienced retail associate
* Strong knowledge of the pet industry and an understanding of how independent pet retailers operate
* A natural ability to build relationships and connect with different personalities
* Confidence talking about products and educating others
* A proactive, self-motivated approach to your work
* Strong organization and follow-up skills
* The ability to manage your own territory and schedule
* A willingness to travel regularly throughout your assigned territory
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation
* A genuine passion for dogs, nutrition, and the pet industry

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a territory where retailers know Yumwoof, understand our products, and are excited to recommend them to their customers.

You will help us increase:

* Active retail locations
* Retailer engagement and product knowledge
* Store-level product visibility
* Reorder rates and sales velocity
* Product assortment per store
* Distributor sales team engagement
* Quality and frequency of store visits and trainings

**Ready for Your Next Step?**

If you've built your experience on the retail floor and are wondering what comes next, this could be it.

Your knowledge of what happens inside a pet store is incredibly valuable. You understand the questions customers ask, what makes store teams recommend one product over another, what good brand support looks like, and what retailers actually need from their partners.

At Yumwoof, you'll have the opportunity to take that experience beyond a single store and use it to support retailers throughout your territory.

We're looking for someone who loves being out in the field, meeting people, building relationships, solving problems, and helping retailers succeed.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

**Why Join Us**

At Yumwoof, we're redefining pet wellness through science-backed, anti-inflammatory recipes made with real ingredients.

We offer:

* Competitive pay and a role with real ownership from day one
* Quarterly bonuses
* 100% remote working environment

**Be Part of a Mission That Matters:** Help dogs live longer, healthier lives through real ingredients, rigorous science, and category-defining product experiences.

**Join an Elite, Autonomous Team:** Work alongside a passionate, ambitious team focused on driving real business outcomes

Roofing Sales Representative — Commercial & Residential

**Roof Replacements**  Repairs **Commercial Maintenance**  
**Location: Southern California | Full-time**

Are you an experienced roofing salesperson who can work independently, prepare accurate estimates, and consistently follow up until a decision is made?

We’re looking for a driven **Commercial & Residential Roofing Sales Representative** who can sell roof replacements, quote repairs, and build lasting customer relationships. **Leads are provided for both commercial and residential roofing.** You bring the roofing knowledge, organization, initiative, and closing ability to turn those opportunities into business.

You’ll work with homeowners, property managers, building owners, landlords, and HOAs, managing opportunities from the first appointment through signed contracts and a thorough handoff to production.

**Exceptional follow-up is a must—especially on commercial proposals.** We need someone who takes ownership after an estimate is sent, stays engaged with decision-makers, and keeps every opportunity moving forward.

What You’ll Do

* **Sell residential and commercial roofing:** Roof replacements, reroofing, repairs, and commercial service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Inspect and assess roofing needs:** Conduct on-site inspections, document conditions with photos and measurements, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* **Quote roof repairs:** Prepare clear, accurate repair estimates for residential and commercial properties, coordinating with production when technical input is needed.
* **Prepare professional proposals:** Clearly explain scope of work, pricing, materials, warranties, and available financing options.
* **Own the follow-up process:** Confirm proposals were received, schedule follow-up conversations, answer questions, address objections, and ask for the sale.
* **Manage commercial sales cycles:** Identify decision-makers, understand budgets and approval timelines, and stay engaged through property manager, ownership, or HOA review.
* **Build recurring business:** Develop commercial maintenance relationships and opportunities for future repairs, replacements, referrals, and additional properties.
* **Manage your pipeline:** Keep CRM records current with inspection notes, proposal status, customer communications, and a scheduled next action for every open opportunity.
* **Work independently:** Organize your appointments, travel, estimates, and follow-up activities while meeting established sales and activity goals.
* **Support a smooth production handoff:** Submit complete contracts, photos, measurements, and scope details so the team can deliver what was sold.
* Generate additional business through referrals, networking, and relationships with local property owners and managers.

Who We’re Looking For

* **At least 2 years of roofing sales experience**, with the ability to handle both residential and commercial opportunities.
* Ability to assess and quote residential and commercial roof repairs—not just full replacements.
* Working knowledge of residential roofing and commercial low-slope roofing systems.
* Familiarity with commercial roofing service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Outstanding follow-up habits:** Persistent, professional, organized, and reliable.
* Proven ability to manage longer sales cycles and communicate with multiple decision-makers.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and closing skills.
* Comfortable using a CRM, preparing proposals, documenting inspections, and managing a sales pipeline.
* A self-starter who can produce results without daily reminders or constant supervision.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to safely access roofs and conduct inspections following company safety procedures.
* Availability for evening and weekend appointments as needed.
* Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.

What We Offer

* **Company-provided commercial and residential leads.**
* Competitive commission structure with uncapped earning potential.
* Multiple sales opportunities: replacements, repairs, and commercial maintenance.
* Ongoing training, product education, and support from experienced roofing professionals.
* Company-branded apparel, marketing support, and inspection tools.
* A team focused on quality workmanship, customer service, and long-term relationships.
* Growth opportunities as we expand across Southern California

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a brief summary of your residential and commercial roofing experience, including your experience estimating repairs and selling maintenance services.

Send a short introduction email.

* What is your name, and where are you located?
* What experience do you have selling residential and commercial roofing?
* Have you personally quoted roof repairs or sold commercial maintenance programs?
* What is your follow-up process after sending a commercial estimate?
* Why would you be a strong addition to our team?

**If you know roofing, take ownership of your opportunities, and understand that consistent follow-up wins business, we want to hear from you.**

**Main Purpose of the Role:**

Support the Marine Operations Manager in ensuring premium service for our Expedite Product and coordinating vessel-arrival and sailing functions for designated West Coast ports in accordance with the Collective Bargaining Agreement and established operational procedures. Maintain daily coordination with terminals regarding berth windows, yard-space allocation, labor requirements, vessel productivity, stowage, discharge, and cargo availability. Assist with the coordination of pilotage, docking, and operational matters involving USCG, CBP, MTOs, stevedore vendors, and other government agencies and external partners. Help ensure the Expedite product is discharged and available within established service-level agreements (SLAs) across all calling terminals, working closely with ZIM Planning and Terminal Planning teams to optimize vessel stowage and prioritize designated containers. Support labor planning, contractual compliance, OOG and breakbulk cargo coordination, vendor invoice review and reconciliation, post-vessel reporting, and tracking of cost-saving opportunities. Provide day-to-day operational follow-up, problem resolution, reporting, vendor coordination, and coverage for the Marine Operations Manager, while supporting customer, terminal, vessel, and other Branch operational needs as assigned.

**Main Tasks:**

Monitor Expedite discharge and availability against SLA across three calling terminals; follow up on and escalate service exceptions.

Maintain daily contact with terminals regarding berth windows, yard-space allocation, labor requirements, productivity, cargo cutoffs, and operational constraints.

Coordinate with ZIM Planning and Terminal Planning teams to support optimized vessel stowage and loading/discharge sequences for priority containers.

Coordinate terminal resource needs to support efficient wheeled operations and monitor vessel activity before arrival and throughout the port stay.

Monitor cold-treatment reefer containers, container activity at the port, and compliance with loading and discharge policies.

Support cost-effective labor-ordering decisions by providing operational information to the Marine Operations Manager and terminal stevedores; review stevedoring invoices for adherence and accuracy.

Support the Marine Operations Manager with daily work coordination, operational coverage, process follow-up, and communication across the department.

Assist with workload tracking, resource coordination, task prioritization, schedules, and operational handoffs.

Provide guidance to employees on established procedures and escalate performance, staffing, or employee-relations matters to the Marine Operations Manager.

Support onboarding and training of new employees and help prepare weekly department meetings, reports, and follow-up items.

Assist with proactive planning for vessel operations, service levels, equipment requirements, and coordination with Branch departments.

Identify and recommend cost-saving opportunities within Marine Operations.

Prepare pricing support and coordinate required approvals for import and export OOG and breakbulk shipments at designated ports.

Support coordination of dangerous, complex, and special cargo and route authorization requests in accordance with applicable terminal and port policies.

Maintain effective working relationships with Expedite service terminals and internal stakeholders in the Los Angeles office.

Work with major shippers of High Value Cargo to coordinate delivery of their cargo prior to or directly to the vessel or truck during cargo operations.

Coordinate daily vessel information and solve complex terminal, vessel, customer, and cargo-flow problems.

  
Requirements:  
  

* Academic education: Maritime College Degree, Shipboard experience, Maritime operational experience.
* Experience: 3-5 years relevant Maritime Industry experience.
* Experience in the shipping/transportation industry in Operations or equivalent is highly preferred.
* Experience working in Union Labor environment and contract knowledge.
* Experience in Stevedoring ( a plus )

jobs.description:
**A LITTLE ABOUT BEEK**

beek is a luxury footwear and accessories brand based in Newport Beach, California, founded in 2014 by two friends, Birgit and Kenna, who share a love for beautiful design, quality leather, and exceptional craftsmanship.

Our philosophy is simple: create timeless, beautifully made pieces that feel as incredible as they look. We believe in quality over quantity, craftsmanship over trends, and designing pieces that only get better with age. What began as a collection of leather footwear has grown to include handbags and accessories, all with the same commitment to thoughtful design, beautiful materials, and uncompromising comfort.

Giving back has also been part of our story since day one. Every pair of shoes sold helps provide meals to children in need through our longtime partnership with Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County. It's a part of our business that means a great deal to us.

**And the team behind beek?** We're a close-knit group of creative, hardworking people who genuinely enjoy what we do. We're collaborative, entrepreneurial, and passionate about the details. We move quickly, wear a lot of hats, and believe that great ideas can come from anyone. We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

We're continuing to grow and are always excited to bring talented, thoughtful people into the mix.

**Position Overview**

**THE ROLE: INFLUENCER MARKETING SPECIALIST**

We're looking for a creative, organized, and relationship-driven Influencer Marketing Specialist to focus on, grow and manage beek's network of influencers, content creators, and VIPs.

You will oversee our influencer program across Instagram and Tiktok, including identifying partners, outreach, building relationships, coordinating product gifting, negotiating collaborations, managing contracts, and ensuring content is delivered. You will also manage our ShopMy affiliate program and all promotional product shipments.

Working closely with our Social Content Coordinator, you'll help identify which creators, partnerships, and content are driving the best results and find ways to leverage that content across social media, advertising, email, and our website to ultimately drive top line revenue.

We're looking for someone who has a great eye for the brand, genuinely enjoys building relationships, works hard, has a thrill for the kill, and knows how to turn connections into meaningful results.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Influencer & Affiliate Marketing:** Scale and manage beek's ShopMy program, including creator recruitment, gifting, commissions, spotlights, opportunities, performance tracking, and ongoing partnerships. Plan yearly budget allocation against monthly revenue goals.
* **PR & VIP Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with influencers, celebrities, stylists, editors, and other tastemakers, working closely with our PR agency.
* **Product Gifting & Seeding:** Oversee all promotional product shipments, coordinating with our operations team to manage inventory, budgets, tracking, and follow-up.
* **Creator Collaborations:** Identify and manage paid and gifted partnerships, including negotiations, contracts, content briefs, timelines, and usage rights. Coordinate creator content shoots as needed.
* **Content & Performance:** Partner with our Social Content Coordinator to evaluate results, identify high-performing creators and content, and maximize the use of that content across social, paid advertising, email, and web.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

**Required**

* 3+ years of experience in influencer marketing or creator partnerships, preferably within fashion, lifestyle, or a consumer brand.
* Experience with ShopMy or similar affiliate platforms such as LTK or Aspire.
* Strong network of influencer, creator, stylist, and PR relationships.
* Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* A creative eye paired with an analytical mindset, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for growth.

**Preferred**

* Experience managing creator partnerships, contracts, budgets, and content usage rights.
* Experience working with PR agencies and coordinating creator content shoots.

The dinners and events we host, plus conferences and other field programs — roughly 15 a year — built with our founding marketer as a peer. The invitation, the experience, and the follow-up are one system. You're measured on qualified conversations and opportunities, not badge scans.

* Build a roughly 15-event calendar of the dinners and events we host and selected conferences, tied to priority accounts and a clear budget.
* Own venues, vendors, sponsorships, shipping, and onsite execution.
* Work with the founding marketer, our CEO, and sales to book meetings before each event.
* Prepare speakers, staffing plans, and run-of-show documents.
* Coordinate lead capture and timely sales follow-up.
* Report cost per qualified meeting, pipeline, and lessons for the next event.

### **What you'll do in your first 90 days**

* Build the first-year calendar — roughly 15 events, including the dinners and events we host as well as conferences — with budget, owners, and a clear reason for each one.
* Lock the next wave of venues, vendors, and logistics.
* Run early dinners or events yourself, and tightly support conference presence with the founding marketer, including pre-booking and onsite execution.
* Stand up the follow-up motion so every event has a path to qualified meetings.
* Report on the first events: cost per qualified meeting, pipeline, and a point of view on what to repeat or drop.

### **You might be a fit if**

* You've independently delivered B2B field programs for several years, including a multi-event calendar and a budget, and you've run dinners or hosted events — not only conference booths.
* You're strong on vendors, logistics, and the unglamorous work that makes an event feel effortless.
* You've worked with sales on account targeting and follow-up, and you care about meetings and pipeline, not badge scans.
* You're based in San Francisco and can travel for events.
* You like building the program from zero, you do the work yourself, and you don't need a team under you to get it done.

### **Nice to have**

* Executive dinner and roundtable experience you ran end to end.
* You've turned events into useful content.

### **Why join**

You'll build our field motion from the ground up, including dinners and events we host ourselves. You'll report to the CEO, work in person in San Francisco with our founding marketer, and stay close to the product and the deals.

### **In-person in San Francisco**

This is a full-time role. We work in person in San Francisco. The role includes travel to conferences and field events.

### **Equal opportunity**

Neon Blue is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, and we provide reasonable accommodations in the hiring process on request. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation Range: $110K - $150K

**About Bobyard**

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who we are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team

* Build the coverage model, health signals, and dashboards that show where to hire and what to automate
* Jump on the hardest customer calls, from estimators to owners

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in B2B SaaS customer success or account management, with 2+ years leading CSMs
* You've managed hundreds of SMB or mid-market accounts, not a dozen whales
* You know your team's GRR, NRR, and churn cold, and can show what you personally moved
* Commercial instinct. You're comfortable owning renewal and expansion targets

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or field-service software experience
* Built customer success operations on HubSpot and Intercom
* Scaled a CS team through a period of fast growth

**A note on pace**

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

You will take control of schedule coordination, ensuring timely follow ups, and improving strategies to scale recruiting operations.  
  
Our ideal candidate is an individual with an extremely high attention to detail, strong sense of pride in the quality of their work, great communication skills, and most importantly someone who understands the rapid pace of startups. ----------------

* Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with inventory tracking systems, spreadsheets, and operational software.

jobs.title: Community Outreach and Recruitment Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Description

The Community Outreach & Recruitment Specialist identifies and develops community referral sources, conducts recruitment of clients for the ADHC, and coordinates timely intake and admission to the Adult Day Health Care (ADHC) program. The Specialist maintains an active referral pipeline, supports supervision of Peer Outreach Workers, and monitors new client engagement and retention during the first 90 days of enrollment.

Essential Job Functions

The following duties are mandatory requirements of the job:

* Coordinates the intake and admissions process, provides accurate program information to prospective clients and referral agencies, responds to inquiries promptly, and monitors referral-to-admission trends.
* Assists prospective clients in obtaining medical and other documentation required for enrollment; logs applications and arranges timely follow-up interviews and intake assessments.
* Responds to referrals from external providers, walk-ins, client referrals, and independently generated outreach leads within one business day of receipt; documents the response and next steps in the appropriate tracking log.
* Maintains and reviews referral, outreach, intake, RAI, and admissions tracking logs at least weekly, using the designated administrative day to reconcile records, follow up on pending items, and identify conversion and attendance trends.
* Collaborates with the Director of Operations/Intake Coordinator to develop and implement targeted outreach strategies focused on adults age 60 and older who meet ADHC eligibility and contractual criteria.
* Establishes and maintains referral accounts and relationships with hospitals, healthcare providers, senior centers, community organizations, social service agencies, and other appropriate sources; visits established accounts at least monthly to sustain a consistent pipeline of qualified prospective clients.
* Conducts a minimum of two days of outside targeted outreach each week; prepares and provides a list of at least four proposed targeted outreach locations for each outreach day, for a minimum of eight location entries per month.
* Conducts a minimum of eight outreach presentations or engagement activities per month, inclusive of presentations and visits to established referral accounts and onsite/offsite tabling activities; documents dates, locations, audiences, contacts, leads, and follow-up outcomes.
* Is responsible for a minimum of five completed admissions per month, with an emphasis on 60 and older clients who meet applicable program and contractual eligibility requirements; monitors progress toward admission and RAI targets and addresses barriers with the supervisor.
* Plans outreach events and complete the established event checklist at least two days before each event, coordinating with Peer Outreach Workers to assemble and verify all required outreach materials before the event.
* Assists the Director of Operations/Intake Coordinator with day-to-day supervision, work assignment, coordination, and accountability of the three Peer Outreach Workers, including outreach follow-up and client retention activities.
* Monitors and tracks new intakes, leads, and enrolled clients during the first 90 days of program participation; assigns and follows up with Peer Outreach Workers on documented 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention contacts and re-engagement for inconsistent attendance.
* Conducts outreach to newly enrolled clients with inconsistent attendance, coordinates appropriate follow-up with Peer Outreach Workers and the program team, and documents retention interventions and outcomes.
* Attends a weekly supervision meeting with the Director of Operations/Intake Coordinator and submits the completed pre-existing weekly supervision template in advance, including names and numbers of individuals outreached, intake counts and status, current RAIs and client names, locations visited and presentations conducted, street outreach status, retention follow-up, barriers, and the next week’s outreach plan.

This role works closely with the Marketing Manager and Director to bring each property’s brand to life across social, email, web, partnerships, and physical touchpoints. **Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY  
The Bernikow JCC Staten Island’s Career Service’s department helps individuals prepare for and secure long-term employment through career counseling, job placement assistance, occupational training, education, and supportive services.  
  
ABOUT YOU  
You will connect residents to Career Services programs and help new participants get ready to start. The coordinator builds relationships with community partners, leads information sessions, guides participants through intake and enrollment, and facilitates orientation. The coordinator serves as the primary point of contact from initial inquiry through orientation and works with Career Services staff and training partners to ensure participants know what to expect, where to report, and whom to contact for support.  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO  
**Community Outreach and Participant Engagement**

* Develop and carry out outreach plans to connect Staten Island residents with Career Services programs, including individuals who face barriers to employment or training.
* Build and maintain referral relationships with schools, community-based organizations, workforce providers, and other local partners. Share program information, eligibility criteria and enrollment timelines.
* Represent Career Services at community events, career fairs, open houses, and partner meetings. Lead in-person and virtual information sessions for prospective participants.
* Respond to inquiries by phone, email and in-person. Explain available programs, eligibility requirements and next steps in clear, accessible language.
* Track outreach activities, inquires, referrals and enrollment by referral source. Use the results to identify which outreach efforts are reaching prospective participants.

**Participant Onboarding**

* Guide incoming participants through intake forms, required documentation, eligibility verification and other steps needed before their program begins
* Maintain accurate and confidential participant records. Track outstanding requirements and follow up with participants before enrollment deadlines.
* Identify barriers that could delay a participant’s start, such as missing documents, transportation needs or technology access. Connect participants with appropriate staff or resources for assistance.

**Orientation and Program Transition**

* Plan and facilitate accessible in-person and virtual orientations for new participants. Revie program schedules, attendance and participation expectations, available supports and key contacts.
* Prepare and update welcome packets, orientation presentations, checklists and resource guides. Coordinate facility tours or virtual platform walkthroughs as needed.
* Track orientation attendance and completion. Follow up with participants who miss orientation or need help preparing for their first day.
* Gather participant feedback and use it to improve orientation materials, delivery and follow-up.

  
OUR REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor’s degree in education, communication, public relations, human services, social work, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in community outreach, participant recruitment, enrollment, program coordination, workforce development or a related area.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate group sessions in person and online and explain program requirements clearly.
* Ability to build relationships with community partners and work respectfully with participants from varied backgrounds.
* Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accurate records.

  
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and spreadsheets. Experience with participant databases, case management systems, or enrollment platforms a plus.
* Ability to safeguard confidential information and follow program documentation and eligibility requirements.
* Availability to work occasional evenings or weekends for outreach events and orientations.

  
SALARY  
$50,000- $55,000 Annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
  
  
BENEFITS  
The JCC of Staten Island is committed to keeping you and your family healthy and happy through a comprehensive benefits program. Offerings include: subsidized options for Medical; offerings for Dental and Vision coverage, FSA and Dependent Care. We also offer free LTD, STD, Life Insurance, a Pension, 403B, generous program discounts, free membership, ample time off and much more!  
  
ABOUT US  
The Jewish Community Center of Staten Island was founded in 1929 with the goal of creating a home for the Jewish community by offering social, recreational, and educational activities. Over time, that mission expanded to help anyone who walked through the doors of any of our facilities. The JCC has become a true community center—not just for the Jewish community, but for the entirety of Staten Island.
  
  
Programs serve the needs we see in our community and are constantly expanding to meet new demand. We serve people of all walks of life, from young children to seniors and everyone in between. The JCC is proud to offer services that help improve the quality of life for people on Staten Island and beyond. We strive to help those in need as well as provide recreational and educational opportunities for our members.  
The JCC of Staten Island is dedicated to encouraging harmony throughout the community by providing facilities and programs that are open to all regardless of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or political affiliation. Everyone is welcome at the JCC.

You will help Checkout.com become the partner of choice for strategic accounts through exceptional value, expertise and commitment.

You will be the voice of your strategic clients across Checkout.com, working closely with the Director, Strategic Account Management and partnering with senior internal stakeholders to unlock expansion opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Strategic planning and governance: Run account plans, strategic business reviews and joint planning sessions with merchants. Keep priorities, risks and opportunities aligned and actively managed across relevant regions and functions.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Mobilise Product, Operations, Legal, Risk, Finance, Data Science and other teams around your accounts' priorities. Lead coordinated responses to complex merchant challenges, remove internal blockers and improve the end-to-end client experience.
* Product, market and business influence: Bring structured client insight and market intelligence back into Checkout.com. Connect client needs, payments trends, competitive dynamics and regulatory developments to clear, actionable product and service recommendations.
* Team and leadership contribution: Share best practice and coach colleagues on account planning, forecasting and executive engagement. Support the Director in building consistent, scalable ways of working across the Strategic Account Management team.

**What We're Looking For**

* Substantial experience in strategic or enterprise account management, customer success or commercial roles in a B2B environment, ideally within FinTech, payments, technology or another complex, high-growth industry.

* Demonstrable experience engaging senior internal and external stakeholders and leading complex commercial discussions.
* Experience building and leveraging relationships across strategic customers, partners and the wider payments ecosystem to create opportunities for insight, collaboration and portfolio growth.
* The ability to move between strategic direction and detailed execution while managing multiple accounts, priorities and workstreams.
* Excellent judgement, problem-solving and influencing skills, with the confidence to lead through ambiguity and manage risk.
* Good knowledge of e-commerce, payments technologies, market dynamics and the trends shaping the industry.
* Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues is a plus.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager – Walmart, Mass & Canada
jobs.description:
**Own Walmart for a challenger brand with big ambitions**

Kabrita is looking for a brand-side account leader to own Walmart USA, grow our Target business, and lead our retail business in Canada. You have run a major mass account for a manufacturer in a structured commercial organization, and you want the scope and visibility of a smaller team. This is a chance to help build the commercial organization we want to become, not just manage the business we have today. It is one of two Key Account Manager roles reporting to the General Manager, with a path into broader Retail Sales leadership as the team grows.

**About Kabrita North America**

Part of Ausnutria, a global leader in dairy nutrition with over a century of expertise, Kabrita makes gentle, goat milk-based formula and foods in the Netherlands under strict European safety standards. We serve more than 60 countries and feed 1.2 million babies a day, because we believe every family deserves a confident start.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the Walmart USA relationship end to end: line reviews, modular resets, store expansion, Walmart.com assortment and replenishment.
* Grow our Target.com business and build the case for in-store distribution as a longer-term objective, while pursuing further mass and modern trade opportunities in the U.S.
* Provide commercial leadership for Kabrita's Canadian retail business, working through our Canada broker to drive distribution, sell-through and profitability.
* Build annual joint business plans and own the sales, trade budget and contribution targets for every account in scope, with regular business reviews against plan.
* Build fact-based category stories with Walmart Retail Link, Circana and SPINS data that show how goat milk formula grows the category, and use them to influence assortment, shelf placement, pricing and promotions.
* Plan promotions within Kabrita's promotion governance with Finance, evaluate every event on ROI, and act quickly when results fall short of plan.
* Direct our broker partners on Walmart, Target and Canada, setting priorities, performance measures and a regular review cadence, and ensure in-store execution.
* Work with Marketing on retailer activations, with Supply Chain on forecasts and new item setup, and with the Key Account Manager for Natural, Grocery & Distributors on channel priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

* Several years of personal, sustained account ownership: you have managed customers directly, built annual account plans, controlled trade budgets and delivered measurable results, ideally within a structured commercial organization such as a large CPG company or a well-run challenger brand.
* 5+ years of key account management for a U.S. consumer goods brand or manufacturer, including direct ownership of a Walmart account; 7+ years preferred. We are specifically looking for brand-side experience, rather than broker, distributor or retailer roles.
* Hands-on Walmart experience, including line reviews, modular resets and item setup, and personal use of Retail Link (required).
* Strong command of Circana and SPINS and of category management principles, and a track record of using them to drive commercial decisions with buyers.
* Proven experience directing broker partners, and a hands-on mindset: you personally drive the business and are comfortable on the ground with customers and brokers.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation and relationship skills, and the ambition to take on greater responsibility and grow into a broader Retail Sales leadership role.
* New Jersey residence (or relocation before your start date), three days per week in our Hoboken office, and regular travel, including to Bentonville, AR and Canada.

**Nice to have**

* Baby nutrition experience is a strong plus; premium pet food, supplements or another specialized category is also valued. Proven account ownership matters more than category.
* Target or Canadian retail experience.

**What We Offer**

Kabrita pays 100% of the premiums for our employee benefits, for you and your family, so you can focus on the work and not on the cost.

* **Medical, dental and vision insurance,** 100% employer-paid, effective on your date of hire.
* **Life, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance,** 100% employer-paid.
* **401(k) with a 100% company match** on up to 6% of your gross salary, beginning 90 days after your start date.

jobs.description:
**Lead and grow a natural, grocery and distributor business for a challenger brand**

Kabrita is looking for a brand-side account leader to own our natural, specialty and grocery business in the U.S., manage our UNFI and KeHE partnerships, and open new doors in conventional grocery. You have owned key accounts for a manufacturer in a structured commercial organization, and you want to personally drive results while coaching an Account Manager. This is a chance to help build the commercial organization we want to become, not just manage the business we have today. It is one of two Key Account Manager roles reporting to the General Manager, with a path into broader Retail Sales leadership as the team grows.

**About Kabrita North America**

Part of Ausnutria, a global leader in dairy nutrition with over a century of expertise, Kabrita makes gentle, goat milk-based formula and foods in the Netherlands under strict European safety standards. We serve more than 60 countries and feed 1.2 million babies a day, because we believe every family deserves a confident start.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the sales plan, trade budget and account contribution for all natural, specialty and grocery accounts, re-accelerating growth with clear account plans and winning new distribution in conventional grocery, from national chains to regional banners.
* Build annual joint business plans with key retailers, lead regular business reviews, and personally manage day-to-day relationships with buyers and category managers.
* Manage the UNFI and KeHE relationships, including distribution, promotional programs and service levels, and control billbacks, chargebacks and deductions in partnership with Finance.
* Plan the promotional calendar across retailer and distributor programs, evaluate every promotion on ROI, velocity and trade-spend efficiency, and act quickly when results fall short of plan.
* Use SPINS and Circana to influence assortment, shelf placement and pricing.
* Direct our broker partners, setting priorities, performance measures and a regular review cadence, and ensure in-store execution, including new item setup, planogram compliance and out-of-stock resolution.
* Lead, coach and develop our Account Manager.
* Work with Marketing on shopper and trade activations, with Supply Chain on forecasts and new item setup, with Finance on account profitability, and with the Key Account Manager for Walmart, Mass & Canada on channel priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

* Several years of personal, sustained account ownership: you have managed customers directly, built annual account plans, controlled trade budgets and delivered measurable results, ideally within a structured commercial organization such as a large CPG company or a well-run challenger brand.
* 5+ years of account management for a U.S. consumer goods brand or manufacturer, with a strong track record in the natural channel; 7+ years preferred. We are specifically looking for brand-side experience, rather than broker, distributor or retailer roles.
* Experience managing UNFI and KeHE for a brand, including distribution, promotional programs and deduction management.
* Experience selling into national and regional grocery chains such as Kroger, Albertsons or Ahold Delhaize.
* Proven trade promotion management and ROI analysis skills, and strong command of SPINS and Circana to drive commercial decisions.
* Experience directing broker partners, and coaching or managing an account manager while still personally driving the business.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills, and the ambition to take on greater responsibility and grow into a broader Retail Sales leadership role.
* New Jersey residence (or relocation before your start date), three days per week in our Hoboken office, and regular travel to customers, brokers and trade events.

**Nice to have**

* Baby nutrition experience is a strong plus; premium pet food, supplements or another specialized category is also valued. Proven account ownership matters more than category.

**What We Offer**

Kabrita pays 100% of the premiums for our employee benefits, for you and your family, so you can focus on the work and not on the cost.

* **Medical, dental and vision insurance,** 100% employer-paid, effective on your date of hire.
* **Life, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance,** 100% employer-paid.
* **401(k) with a 100% company match** on up to 6% of your gross salary, beginning 90 days after your start date.
* **Generous time off:** 10 paid holidays and 15 vacation days per year (unused vacation can roll forward), plus 6 sick days and 5 personal days.
* **$2,000 annual continuing education allowance** to support your professional growth.

Kabrita North America is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Juicebox**

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams **win the talent war**.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside **5,000+** customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR **with 20%+ monthly growth**, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over **$116M** in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

**About the Role**

Customer Success at Juicebox sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, AI workflow enablement, and customer strategy. CSMs own the full customer relationship—from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal—while serving as trusted advisors and AI workflow experts.

Our customers range from enterprise talent teams to startup founders, staffing firms, and VC talent partners. As a PLG business, customers start small and scale quickly, so you'll often be managing onboarding, expansion, and renewal motions simultaneously.

You'll help define what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company shaping a new category. Our customers love the product, embrace innovation, and genuinely enjoy partnering with us. You'll do it alongside a low-ego, collaborative team and work directly with a VP of CS who has built world-class organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.

**You Will…**

* Own a portfolio of customers and drive measurable outcomes across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
* Lead customer success plans, align on key metrics, and ensure talent leaders realize value quickly.
* Drive adoption of AI-native workflows, guide change management, and help customers reach their first “aha” moment and beyond.
* Own commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing negotiations, and complex buying processes.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities across teams, stakeholders, and product offerings.
* Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with end users, champions, TA Ops leaders, and hiring managers.
* Lead ROI discussions and QBRs that demonstrate impact and strengthen partnerships.
* Help define and improve the Customer Success playbook by identifying gaps, solving problems, and scaling best practices.
* Live or be willing to relocate to New York City

**You Have…**

* 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales with ownership of a revenue target and a portfolio of 75-150 accounts.
* A track record of exceeding commercial goals and driving customer growth.
* The ability to manage multiple customer conversations and priorities simultaneously.
* A builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity before a playbook exists.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience in SaaS, consulting, HR tech, or talent tech; recruiting industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

**Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees**

* **Top-of-market compensation** with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.
* **Daily meals provided:** breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

**For US Employees:**

* **Comprehensive healthcare** with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.
* **$2,000 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
* **$300/month commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

**For UK Employees:**

* **Comprehensive private medical insurance** with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.
* **£1,500 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being
* **£3,500/year commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

Compensation Range: $165K - $230K

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the team and role**
---------------------------

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers.** After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
* **Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert.** Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.
* **Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments.** Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.
* **Lead new-product implementations for existing customers.** Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.
* **Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews.** Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.
* **Build customer champions and drive change.** Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. Create enablement and change-management plans, including train-the-trainer approaches where useful, that equip customer teams to adopt new capabilities and sustain new ways of working beyond individual stakeholders.
* **Manage customer health proactively.** Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.
* **Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs).** Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.
* **Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion.** Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.

**What you need**
-----------------

* A track record in enterprise customer success, including hands-on ownership of implementation, adoption, and ongoing value realization for complex customers.
* Strong product aptitude and experience configuring and optimizing software to support customer business processes—not just advising from a distance.
* Experience managing customer-facing implementations, from discovery and project planning through training, launch, and sustained adoption.

**Launch Your Sales Career. Learn. Earn. Advance. – Career Track to High Six-Figure Earnings**

At **Fora Financial**, we're not just offering a job—we're offering a launchpad. Our **Inside Sales Associate** role is designed specifically for **entry-level professionals who are ready to train, grow, and rise quickly into a high-impact, high-income sales role**.

In this role, you'll receive **intensive hands-on training** from top-performing sales leaders, giving you the tools and real-time experience to succeed. This is your opportunity to learn sales the right way, from the ground up, with an average path to promotion as early as 6–12 months.

  

**What You'll Do as an Inside Sales Associate:**

* Serve as the **first point of contact** for small business owners across the country, helping them explore working capital solutions tailored to their business goals
* Learn and apply a **consultative sales approach** while honing your communication and active listening skills
* Manage a steady stream of **inbound leads** (no cold calling), using Salesforce to track pipeline activity and follow-ups
* Participate in our structured **Sales & Development Training Program**, designed to accelerate your knowledge, confidence, and sales effectiveness
* Collaborate daily with a team of supportive leaders and colleagues who are invested in your growth
  

**Compensation & Perks:**

* **On Target Earnings: $80,000** + (50,000 base with average ~$2,500/month during initial ramp-up with top performers earning up to 5,000+/month commission)
* Performance-based **bonuses**, weekly and monthly contests, and team incentives
* **Ongoing coaching** from senior leaders, plus access to internal training programs and e-learning
* Fun, driven office culture with team events, happy hours, and more
* Free breakfast, snacks, and weekly lunch in the office
* **Hybrid work option** (1 day remote per week)
  

**What We're Looking For:**

We're looking for individuals who are:

* **Hungry to learn** and build a successful career in sales
* **Coachable**, with a growth mindset and strong work ethic
* Highly motivated by **financial success** and long-term advancement
* Great at **listening**, asking smart questions, and building rapport over the phone
* Confident, articulate, and able to **thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment**
  

**About Fora Financial**

Fora Financial is a technology enabled, leading provider of flexible financing to small and medium sized businesses. Since our inception in 2008, we have supported more than 55,000 merchants nationwide with over $5 billion of capital used for a variety of purposes, from funding everyday operating expenses to managing cash flow gaps to facilitating business expansion, and much more. Leveraging our proprietary technology, Fora Financial is able to deliver capital to our customers via a streamlined and simple process that can be completed in as little as 24 hours, compared with the weeks or even months it often takes for a business to receive a bank loan.

Over the past eighteen years, Fora Financial has grown from two founders in a small Manhattan workspace to a company of nearly 200 employees. Fora Financial prides itself on being a partner-centric organization, offering a customized funding approach, collaborating with our small-business customers to understand their needs in a dynamic and ever-changing economic environment.

We offer a competitive salary, growth potential, and a casual yet professional hybrid work environment. Located in the heart of midtown Manhattan, you can enjoy lunch downstairs listening to the summer band series or around the corner in Bryant Park. After work, you can hop on a Citi Bike to ride to the Hudson River Park, take a stroll to a show on Broadway or attend an event at Madison Square Garden. Our office sets the stage for our employees' success and well-being. We provide all the tools and support needed to maximize your career potential, in addition to perks and extras like daily breakfasts, endless snacks, catered lunches, a chill lounge/games area and more. While we work very hard, we do not take ourselves too seriously. We enjoy a family-like camaraderie that fosters a passion for success in each Fora Financial Team member.

* Medical, Dental, Vision Coverage
* 401k Plan with Company Match
* Gym Reimbursement for Employees on Medical Plans
* Life Insurance at No Cost to Employees
* Generous Time Off Plan
