**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the team and role**
---------------------------

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers.** After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
* **Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert.** Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.
* **Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments.** Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.
* **Lead new-product implementations for existing customers.** Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.
* **Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews.** Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.
* **Build customer champions and drive change.** Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. * **Manage customer health proactively.** Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.
* **Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs).** Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.
* **Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion.** Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Mid Market
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**How you'll make impact**
--------------------------

As a founding Sales Development Representative, you’ll help establish Airwallex’s US Mid-Market go-to-market motion for companies with 500–2,000 employees and global financial operations. You’ll generate and cultivate opportunities through strategic messaging to decision-makers, build relationships with executive stakeholders, and partner with Account Executives to move opportunities forward toward a target ACV of $100k. You’ll help develop outbound strategies, shape sales processes, relay market feedback globally, and work with Product and Engineering to influence product strategy and improve the client experience.

You’ll work from our New York or San Francisco office. CONFIRM: required days in the office.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Essentials**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 12 months of experience in sales, account management, or a related customer-service role
* Experience in a startup, fintech, or B2B software environment
* A goal-oriented approach and enthusiasm for generating and nurturing relationships with decision-makers
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build rapport by phone and email
* Ability to collaborate with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to create and nurture opportunities
* Curiosity and the ability to research leaders across functions such as Engineering, Product, and Finance
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and help build new sales processes in an early-stage team

**Preferred**

* Experience developing outbound strategies with Account Executives
* Experience engaging executive stakeholders or supporting complex product discussions
* Experience working with global teams across diverse offices and time zones
* Experience in a customer-facing role where you owned resolution of customer needs and protected the customer experience

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.
* You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
* You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.
* You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.
* You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

### **Learn more about your team**

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation Range: $135K - $150K

jobs.title: Artistic Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The New Jersey Symphony seeks a full-time **Artistic Operations Coordinator** to join a high-performing team of five. This position works closely in both Artistic Planning and Orchestral Operations.

**Department:** Artistic Operations
  
**Status:** Full-Time, Exempt
  
**Reports to:** Director of Orchestral Operations with secondary oversight from the Director of Artistic Planning
  
**Salary Range:** $44,000-$50,000 annually
  
**Application Deadline:** December 1, 2026
  
**Start Date:** ASAP

#### **About the Role**

The Artistic Operations Coordinator position offers high-level experience in all aspects of orchestral operations. There are regular opportunities to work with and be mentored by senior employees, and the position involves exposure to major performing artists and a vibrant community of professional musicians.

The ideal candidate will be someone who can seamlessly facilitate and support all aspects of the Artistic Operations department's duties, bringing a positive, team-oriented attitude and a collaborative spirit to this position. Currently, all New Jersey Symphony employees work on a hybrid basis, working at the orchestra's office, at the performance venues, and from home. Routine on-site evenings and weekends will be required.

**Artistic**

* As assigned by the Director of Artistic Planning, manage artist needs at rehearsals and performances, including setting up and breaking down dressing rooms, providing hospitality such as refreshments, water, and towels, and functioning as an artist’s primary point of connection to the organization around orchestra services.
* Support the Director of Artistic Planning in arranging travel and hospitality, procuring department supplies, and other tasks as assigned.
* Maintain an effective relationship with hotels, car services, and other local vendors.
* Work collaboratively with other NJ Symphony departments. This includes attending marketing content meetings and working with development and education departments on receptions, masterclasses, and other artist appearances.

#### **Qualifications**

* Familiarity with live performing arts, specifically classical music.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/training in classical music, music education or related field.
* Proficiency in standard Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to be organized, proactive and focused.
* Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
* High level of professionalism and the ability to handle confidential information.
* The discipline to work independently, but also the ability to function as a member of a team. Concert and event management experience beneficial but not required.
* OPAS (Orchestra Planning and Administration System), Visio/CAD and database experience helpful but not required.

#### **Working Conditions/Physical Demands**

* Some functions of the job will be performed during the evenings and on Saturdays and Sundays, as New Jersey Symphony's performance schedule dictates.
* Access to an automobile and valid driver's license are encouraged since occasionally venues are not directly accessible through public transportation.
* The employee must be able to lift 20lbs. Employee will occasionally be standing on uneven surfaces and navigating narrow backstage spaces.
* Employee must be able speak into a microphone, communicate and listen on a headset.

* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a deadline-driven environment

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.  
  
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:  
  
  
  
The Office of Enforcement and Neighborhood Services (OENS) leads the agency’s effort to work closely with other HPD divisions and outside community partners to identify buildings in distress, assess and develop appropriate strategies to address those properties and work closely with responsible owners to develop a plan to improve conditions and return buildings to firm financial footing and physical health. OENS uses enforcement tools within its Division of Code Enforcement, Housing Litigation Division, Emergency Operations and Enhanced Enforcement, and the Division of Neighborhood Preservation to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.
  
  
The Office of Enforcement of Neighborhood Services is composed of seven divisions: Data Management & Technology (DMT), Division of Neighborhood Preservation (DNP), Administration & Internal Compliance (AIC), Housing Litigation Division (HLD), Division of Code Enforcement (DCE), Emergency Operations and Enhanced Enforcement Division (EOD)
  
  
and Division of Emergency Housing Services (EHS).  
  
  
  
Your Impact:  
  
  
  
As the Community Coordinator in the Exec Office of Enforcement of Neighborhood Services, you will work on projects related to planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of key strategic objectives and goals within the Fix the City Initiative. Reporting directly to the Director, this role will initially focus on processing requests for inspection from the Division of Code Enforcement, scheduling coordinating meetings with other Offices/Divisions of HPD and external agencies, gathering data related to identified owner portfolios, tracking of next steps and monitoring outcomes of designated strategies.
  
  
Your Role:
  
  
As a Community Coordinator/Administrative Support within the Exec Office of Enforcement of Neighborhood Services (OENS), your duties will include, but not be limited to, the following:
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Assisting with seamless coordination and implementation of initiative-led projects.

  

* Reviewing operational methods and procedures to ensure completeness, compliance, and accuracy of program requirements.

  

* Participating in the refinement of existing reporting metrics and drive the development of new metrics to track initiative success.

  

* Assisting in the preparation, analysis, and refinement of operational materials for program improvement projects, delivering data-driven recommendations for procedure enhancements.

  

* Performing other tasks and handle strategic, ad-hoc projects as assigned by the Director.

  
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  
  

* Experience: 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, community program management, or a related analyst role.

  

* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to evaluate reports, analyze system requirements, and interpret operational data.

  

* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for preparing materials, reports, and strategic recommendations.

  

* Organization: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple project timelines and shifting mandates simultaneously.

  

* Software Proficiency: Strong skills in project management tools and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
  
2. High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
  
3. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.

**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.

**About Georgia Tech**

Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.

2. We strive for excellence.

goals.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. Equivalent education and experience may be considered.

* Ability to work in a team environment and meet or exceed Performance Competencies.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Plan it. Run it. Make them say “Wow!”**

Are you the one everyone hands the planning to? The person who spots the misspelt name badge, the coffee running low and the speaker who looks nervous, and quietly fixes all three before anyone else notices? Maybe you've spent a couple of years supporting events, and you're ready to run your own. Or maybe you've been the organised one on an executive support team and realised the events were the best part of the job.

If you want to put your own creative stamp on events that leaders, clients and colleagues remember, this is a great place to start.

TransPerfect runs a world-class events program: hundreds of events a year, from conferences, forums and panels to thought-leadership sessions and internal summits. They're local, regional, national and international, and every one is a little different. That variety is the point. You'll get real ownership, a portfolio of events to call your own, and a budget to make them impressive.

As part of our Global Marketing and Communications team, you'll lead some events yourself and join the team on others, learning from experienced event leaders as you go. Either way, you'll be trusted with the details that make an event great and encouraged to bring the ideas that make it unforgettable. And yes, you'll travel and see new places regularly.

**Day to day, you'll:**

* **Run your own events.** Take a portfolio of internal and external events from first idea through planning to delivery, with an impeccable eye for detail at every step.
* **Make your mark.** Bring fresh, creative ideas to every event you oversee, so attendees leave saying “Wow!”
* **Make the budget work hard.** Own the budget for your events and get the most out of every pound and dollar while keeping the experience impressive.
* **Get the best from our partners.** Work with TransPerfect's key suppliers to get real value from those relationships, both on cost and on the service we receive.
* **Know why every event exists.** Work closely with key stakeholders, the executive support team and other internal teams to understand the business goals behind each event, and make sure they're met.
* **Keep everything visible.** Use our proprietary online event management platform to track processes, costs and tasks, giving senior management a clear view of the whole program.
* **Be there when it happens.** Supervise events on-site, so they run smoothly, efficiently and on schedule.
* Some events you'll run on your own or with a small team behind you. On others, you'll be part of a team supporting another lead. Both will make you better at this.

**What's the directive? Sweat the details, bring the ideas, and make people say “Wow!”**

**What matters most**

Hands-on event experience and the instinct to go the extra mile. We want to hear about events you've helped plan and run: the problems you solved before anyone noticed, the ideas you brought to the table, the moments you're proud of. You don't need to have done it all yet. You need the drive to learn fast, the organisation to keep a dozen moving parts on track, and the calm to keep smiling when one of them breaks.

**The measurables**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in marketing or a related field
* 2-4 years of proven events experience
* Prior work on events and/or in executive support
* Brand management or brand development experience
* Clear, confident communication, written and verbal
* Basic design skills (PowerPoint, Canva or similar)
* Highly organised, efficient and detail-oriented, with real respect for timelines, processes and structure
* Calm and effective under pressure, with tight deadlines and in high-stakes moments
* Confident, professional and personable with everyone from interns to C-level executives, inside and outside the company
* A service mindset and an excellence reflex: proactive, and always ready to go the extra mile
* Available to travel 10–20% of the time, sometimes at short notice

**Is this you?**

From the audience, events look effortless. Behind the scenes, they're early starts, late finishes, last-minute changes and a hundred small decisions nobody notices when they're done right. If that sounds like hard work, you're right. If it also sounds like fun, you'll fit right in. Do it well, and you'll build a portfolio of events that are clearly yours, and earn the chance to take on bigger ones.

*Applicants should be ready to share examples of events they've worked on and are proud of.*

jobs.description:
**Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist**

**Recovery Oriented Systems of Care (ROSC)**

PEER Services (peerservices.org) is a leading nonprofit provider of community-based substance use prevention and treatment services for Evanston, Maine, New Trier, Niles and Northfield Townships, and the north side of Chicago. As a licensed treatment provider since 1975, we have transformed the lives of thousands of teens and adults and helped them open the door to a healthier, brighter future.

**About ROSC**

In 2018, the Illinois Department of Human Services Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (IDHS/DBHR) launched Recovery-Oriented Systems of Care (ROSC) Councils across Illinois to strengthen recovery supports and improve outcomes for individuals affected by substance use and co-occurring mental health conditions. ROSC Councils bring together community members, service providers, organizations, and individuals with lived experience to build recovery-ready communities. Through collaboration, education, and advocacy, ROSC Councils work to reduce stigma, advance harm reduction, promote evidence-based recovery practices, improve access to services, and reduce barriers to treatment and recovery.

**Position Summary**

The NCC ROSC Coalition is seeking a Part-Time Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist (ROSC-COES) to support outreach, partnership development, coalition coordination, communications, and projects throughout Northern Cook County. Working alongside the ROSC Coalition Coordinator, this individual will represent the coalition in the community and build relationships that strengthen recovery supports and reduce barriers to care.

*This is a non-clinical position and does not include counseling, case management, treatment services, or clinical interventions.*

The ROSC Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist supports the development and implementation of our Recovery Oriented Systems of Care Program in collaboration with the ROSC Coordinator, and reports to the SUD Program Manager.

The ROSC Community Outreach and Engagement Specialist has a unique and integral role as a member of the PEER ROSC. The ROSC-COES has lived experience with substance use recovery and is comfortable with appropriate self-disclosure and sharing pertinent information about their own recovery experiences with others to educate and build community support for people with substance use disorders. The ROSC-COES is encouraged to utilize their lived experience to connect with community members, and advocate for those in recovery from substance use. In addition, the ROSC-COES works with the ROSC Coordinator to educate staff, community members, and other stakeholders on the needs of those in recovery, the RSS model, and role in recovery. The ROSC-COES must be stable in their own recovery for a minimum of two years. The ROSC-COES abides by the ethical standards, basic values, principles, and guidelines for peer recovery support practice. Additionally, the ROSC-COES is responsible for assisting the ROSC Coordinator in cultivating and maintaining relationships with community partners, persons in recovery, and other stakeholders. The ROSC-COES provides administrative assistance, as directed by the SUD Services Director and ROSC Coordinator.

Job Duties:

**Community Engagement Specialist Responsibilities**

**Community Outreach & Partnership Development**

· Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, healthcare and social service providers, schools, faith-based groups, businesses, and other stakeholders through outreach and consistent follow-up.

· Engage partners through phone calls, emails, and in-person meetings; represent the NCC ROSC Coalition at networking events, resource fairs, and community gatherings.

· Research community resources, partnership opportunities, and best practices to identify collaborative projects that strengthen recovery-oriented systems of care.

· Attend scheduled ROSC Coalition meetings, TA meetings, regional meetings, and statewide meetings.

**Coalition Support & Initiative Advancement**

· Assist with the implementation of coalition goals, deliverables, strategic initiatives, and projects assigned by the ROSC Coalition Coordinator.

· Support event planning, meeting logistics, and stakeholder engagement, including planning, coordinating, and co-facilitating the monthly Northern Cook County ROSC Coalition meeting.

· Prepare meeting minutes, organize electronic files and coalition records, and assist with data collection and reporting on coalition activities.

**Communications & Resource Development**

jobs.title: Roofing Sales Representative / Account Manager
jobs.description:
John Beal Roofing is hiring Roofing Sales Representatives in the Chicago Suburbs market. No roofing experience is required and we train you from the ground up. You do need to be comfortable working at height — you will be on roofs and ladders — and you need a valid driver's license and your own reliable transportation. Apply with the form on this page or call 1-800-564-6232.

**Now hiring in Chicago Suburbs.** The Chicago suburbs are one of the largest residential roofing markets in the country, with hail, lake-effect wind and freeze-thaw cycles working on millions of homes across DuPage, Will, Kane and Cook counties. John Beal Roofing is expanding into the Chicago Suburbs area and is looking for its first salesmen and account managers there — people who want to get in early, own a territory, and grow with the market.

This is the role that drives everything else at this company. You meet homeowners after a storm or at the end of a roof's life, get on the roof, document what you find, explain it in plain language, and carry the job through to a finished roof. **Earnings start at $100,000 a year** and are commission-based, so what you make follows what you sell and how well you take care of people.

**What you will actually do**
-----------------------------

* **Inspect roofs.** Get on the roof, photograph and measure damage, and document it slope by slope.
* **Educate, don't pressure.** Walk homeowners through what you found and what their options are. We sell by being the honest one in the driveway.
* **Work insurance claims.** Meet adjusters on site and make sure the scope reflects the damage the policy owes. We train you on this — it is the part most people have never done before.
* **Own the relationship.** Stay with your customer from the first inspection through the finished roof and the final walkthrough.
* **Build your territory** across Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and the surrounding Chicago Suburbs area.

**What we require**
-------------------

* **No experience necessary.** Some of our strongest people came from restaurants, retail, construction and the military.
* **You cannot be afraid of heights.** This job puts you on roofs. If that is a problem, this is the wrong role — and that is fine, we hire for other positions too.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Willingness to learn roofing, insurance and claims knowledge you can build a long career on.
* Comfort talking with homeowners and following through on what you promised.

**Why people stay here**
------------------------

* **Family-owned, not a storm-chaser.** The owner's name is on the building. You will meet him.
* **Year-round work.** 10+ local offices serving homeowners in five states means we are not idle when one area goes quiet.
* **Promotion from within.** Our managers came up through the field, not from a corporate transfer.
* **A brand that opens doors.** A BBB Torch Award for marketplace ethics and a lifetime workmanship warranty behind what you sell.
* **Real training.** Roofing, insurance and claims knowledge, taught here.

**Where you will work**
-----------------------

This position is based in the Chicago Suburbs market (the Chicago suburbs, IL), covering Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and the surrounding communities. Our hiring line for this market is 1-800-564-6232.

**How to apply**
----------------

Use the form on this page — it goes straight to our hiring team, with no portal and no account to create. You can also call 1-800-564-6232 or our main line at 1-800-564-6232. We are also hiring production crews, project managers, insurance claim specialists, commercial estimators and office staff — see all open positions.

**Frequently asked questions**
------------------------------

Do I need roofing experience to apply for this job?

No. No experience is required. We train you on roofing, inspections, insurance and claims. Experience is welcome but work ethic matters more.

Do I have to get on the roof?

Yes. Inspecting and documenting roofs is a core part of this role, so you cannot be afraid of heights. If heights are a problem, ask us about our office, estimating and project management roles instead.

How much does this job pay?

Earnings start at $100,000 a year. The role is commission-based, so what you sell drives what you make. We go through the specifics during the interview.

Which cities does this position cover?

The Chicago Suburbs market, including Naperville, IL, Aurora, IL, Joliet, IL, Schaumburg, IL, Arlington Heights, IL, Orland Park, IL, Wheaton, IL, Elgin, IL and surrounding communities.

How do I apply?

Submit the form on this page or call 1-800-564-6232. It goes directly to our hiring team — no portal, no account.

jobs.title: Marketing Content Specialist - Part-Time
jobs.description:
Korwitts Chiropractic, P.C. is an established, patient-centered chiropractic and wellness practice in Downers Grove, IL. We pride ourselves on high clinical integrity, authentic patient education, and transparent communication. We are looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy local **Marketing, Content & Social Media Coordinator** to manage our organic social media, short-form video creation, Meta lead generation ads, and routine WordPress website updates.

Ideally, you love the natural wellness industry and are familiar with chiropractic and related services. This is a part-time position involving 12-15 hours a week with potential to grow. You will be on-site 1-2 days per week with some remote flexibility. You must be located in the Chicago area.

### **To Apply**

* **Portfolio Check:** Along with your Resume. Share links or examples of 2–3 social media posts, Reels, or ad graphics you personally created and managed for a business page. Briefly note what tools you used.
* **Compliance & Approval Scenario:** In healthcare marketing, promotional offers (such as a discounted new-patient exam) require specific legal disclaimers and strict adherence to approved clinical services. How do you structure your pre-launch checklist to guarantee that zero unapproved offers or missing disclaimers ever go live?
* **Platform & WordPress Comfort:** We do have a WordPress website, and you will be doing updates and additions to the site along with working with our social media content. Are you experienced managing organic Facebook and Instagram calendars through Meta Business Suite, running lead ads inside a client-owned Meta Business Manager account, and editing pages inside WordPress (specifically Elementor)?

 **Compensation:**

$20 - $25 hourly

 **Responsibilities:**

**What You Will Do:**

* **Facebook & Instagram Page Management & Content Creation:** Plan, design, schedule, and publish consistent weekly organic content across our Facebook and Instagram accounts (educational graphics, posture/mobility tips, clinic updates, and community highlights) using tools like Canva and Meta Business Suite. Monitor comments and direct messages promptly and professionally, routing any clinical or scheduling inquiries to our front desk.
* **In-Clinic Video Capture & Editing:** Visit our Downers Grove clinic 1–2 times per week to film crisp, natural vertical videos (Reels/Shorts) of Dr. Korwitts, patient education clips, clinic culture, and approved patient testimonials. Edit cleanly (CapCut/Premiere/Canva) with accurate captions and natural color—no heavy AI face-warping or over-processed filters.
* **Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Lead Ads:** Build, monitor, and optimize local lead-generation campaigns inside **our clinic’s Meta Business Manager** (the clinic retains full ownership of all ad accounts, pixels, and billing).
* **Healthcare Compliance & Pre-Approval:** Strictly adhere to healthcare marketing compliance—including mandatory federal Medicare/Medicaid exclusions on promotional offers and signed patient media releases—and submit all content calendars, ad copy, graphics, and videos for written sign-off from leadership before publishing.
* **WordPress / Elementor Website Updates:** Perform routine front-end updates on our WordPress/Elementor website (swapping images, posting educational blogs/condition pages using existing templates, and verifying contact forms). Hosting infrastructure and server security are managed separately by our HIPAA-compliant host.

 **Qualifications:**

**Who You Are:**

* **Detail-Obsessed & Compliance-Minded:** You double-check every frame of a video and every line of ad copy before hitting publish. You never push unapproved changes or offers live.
* **Strong Eye for Authentic Visuals:** You know how to shoot clean smartphone video with good lighting and audio, and your portfolio shows natural, polished edits rather than blurry or distorted AI templates.
* **Experienced With Meta Ads Manager & WordPress:** You are comfortable navigating Meta Ads Manager lead forms, basic audience targeting, and WordPress page builders (Elementor experience is a big plus).
* **Reliable & Local:** Able to commute reliably to Downers Grove, IL 1–2 mornings or afternoons per week for filming and brief team check-ins.

 **About Company**

Since 1987, Korwitts Chiropractic Center has served Downers Grove and the western suburbs with one guiding mission: helping people live healthier, more active, and more fulfilling lives. Our multidisciplinary team brings together a wide range of natural healthcare services, all designed to address the underlying causes of health concerns while supporting the unique needs of each patient. While our treatment approaches may vary, they are united by a common philosophy: every individual deserves personalized care, education, and the opportunity to achieve the highest level of health possible.

Griswold Receivers is seeking a full-time California Receivership Project Coordinator to support the management and oversight of 40–45 active receivership projects. This is a hybrid role that will include traveling to properties across Northern California and Nevada as needed.

In the field, you’ll conduct site inspections, coordinate with city inspectors and contractors to plan and schedule work, manage property needs such as utility setup, fencing, and security, help relocate occupants and tenants, and track overall project progress. The Project Coordinator will report to the Director, Northern California Property Management and work closely with the Operations Team to carry out day-to-day tasks for each project.

The Receivership Project Coordinator will help coordinate receivership projects from start to finish, keeping them on time, on budget, and done well. We’re looking for a proactive team player who likes working with others and takes initiative to keep projects moving. Partnering closely with the Director of Northern California Property Management, this role monitors properties, resolves issues quickly, and plays a key part in carrying out court-appointed receivership responsibilities.

 **Compensation:**

$75,000 - $85,000

 **Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple receivership projects from start to finish.
* Travel to properties throughout Northern California and Nevada to conduct inspections, monitor progress, and address issues.
* Work with city inspectors, contractors, and vendors to schedule and plan required work.
* Assist with the setup and management of property services, including utilities, fencing, and security.
* Support the relocation of occupants and tenants as needed, including identifying options and coordinating logistics.
* Monitor project timelines to keep projects on track.
* Maintain accurate records of property conditions and work performed, including photos and inspection notes.
* Prepare regular status updates and reports for the Director and Operations Team.
* Respond to urgent property issues such as damage, vandalism, or security concerns.
* Act as a point of contact for tenants and neighbors, handling concerns professionally and maintaining positive relationships.
* Work with internal teams and outside stakeholders to keep projects running efficiently.

 **Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of property management and/or construction management experience.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic project management tools.

 **About Company**

Griswold Receivers and its professionals serve exclusively as Court-appointed neutrals in a variety of legal scenarios, including health & safety receiverships, tenant habitability receiverships, post-judgment receiverships, business dispute receiverships, rents/profits receiverships, and partition actions. These matters often lead to a variety of types of rehabilitation and construction projects.

We embrace a team-centric environment and approach to support one another in our respective roles, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to take on different roles as the project may require. Our team possesses a high level of integrity and keeps a level head during high-pressure or potentially volatile situations without losing sight of the end goal.

Salary is dependent on experience & skillset. Benefits include an incentive plan, 401(k) (after waiting period), paid holidays, wellness reimbursement program, and paid time off.

new_jobs.description:
**About Yumwoof**

Yumwoof is a fast-growing premium dog food brand focused on creating better, healthier food for dogs. As we continue expanding our retail and distribution footprint across the U.S., we are looking for a motivated and passionate **Field Sales Representative** (**based in California, Nevada, Washington, Oregon, and/or Florida**) to help us build strong relationships with our retail partners and support our growth in the market.

**About the Role**

As a Field Sales Representative at Yumwoof, you will be the face of our brand for independent pet retailers in your territory.

Your primary responsibility will be to support our retail partners, work closely with our distributors and their sales teams, and make sure Yumwoof is represented successfully at store level.

This is a hands-on field role with **approximately 75% travel within your assigned territory.** You will spend significant time visiting stores, building relationships with store owners and managers, training retail teams, supporting distributor sales representatives, and identifying opportunities to grow Yumwoof within existing and new independent accounts. You will also actively prospect for new business through **in-person visits to independent pet retailers** within your territory.

**This role can also be a great fit for someone currently working in pet retail.** If you are an experienced store manager, assistant manager, department lead, or retail team member who knows the pet industry, understands how independent pet stores operate, and is ready to take the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We care about your ability to connect with people, understand retailers, learn quickly, take ownership, and represent Yumwoof with enthusiasm.

**What You'll Do**

* Visit independent pet retailers throughout your assigned territory
* Build strong relationships with store owners, managers, and retail teams
* Educate and train store employees on Yumwoof products, ingredients, benefits, and key selling points
* Conduct product trainings, store visits, and in-store demonstrations
* Work closely with our distribution partners and participate in distributor sales rep ride-alongs
* Support distributor sales representatives with product knowledge and retailer conversations
* Help introduce Yumwoof to new retail locations within the territory
* Increase product visibility, placement, and assortment within existing accounts
* Ensure Yumwoof products, displays, and marketing materials are properly represented in stores
* Identify stores that need additional support, training, samples, or marketing materials
* Help drive reorders and improve sales performance within existing retail accounts
* Gather feedback from retailers and communicate market insights back to the Yumwoof team
* Track store visits, trainings, opportunities, and follow-up actions
* Attend distributor events, trade shows, retailer events, and other industry events as needed
* Collaborate closely with Yumwoof's Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams

**Who We're Looking For**

We are open to candidates coming from different backgrounds.

You could already be working in field sales or territory management, or you could be an experienced pet retail professional who is ready to move from working inside one store to building relationships with retailers across an entire territory.

You may be a great fit if you have:

* Experience in pet retail, field sales, territory sales, account management, or another customer-facing role
* Experience as a pet store manager, assistant manager, department lead, or experienced retail associate
* Strong knowledge of the pet industry and an understanding of how independent pet retailers operate
* A natural ability to build relationships and connect with different personalities
* Confidence talking about products and educating others
* A proactive, self-motivated approach to your work
* Strong organization and follow-up skills
* The ability to manage your own territory and schedule
* A willingness to travel regularly throughout your assigned territory
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation
* A genuine passion for dogs, nutrition, and the pet industry

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a territory where retailers know Yumwoof, understand our products, and are excited to recommend them to their customers.

You will help us increase:

* Active retail locations
* Retailer engagement and product knowledge
* Store-level product visibility
* Reorder rates and sales velocity
* Product assortment per store
* Distributor sales team engagement
* Quality and frequency of store visits and trainings

**Ready for Your Next Step?**

If you've built your experience on the retail floor and are wondering what comes next, this could be it.

Your knowledge of what happens inside a pet store is incredibly valuable. You understand the questions customers ask, what makes store teams recommend one product over another, what good brand support looks like, and what retailers actually need from their partners.

At Yumwoof, you'll have the opportunity to take that experience beyond a single store and use it to support retailers throughout your territory.

We're looking for someone who loves being out in the field, meeting people, building relationships, solving problems, and helping retailers succeed.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

**Why Join Us**

At Yumwoof, we're redefining pet wellness through science-backed, anti-inflammatory recipes made with real ingredients.

We offer:

* Competitive pay and a role with real ownership from day one
* Quarterly bonuses
* 100% remote working environment

**Be Part of a Mission That Matters:** Help dogs live longer, healthier lives through real ingredients, rigorous science, and category-defining product experiences.

**Join an Elite, Autonomous Team:** Work alongside a passionate, ambitious team focused on driving real business outcomes

Are you an experienced roofing salesperson who can work independently, prepare accurate estimates, and consistently follow up until a decision is made?

We’re looking for a driven **Commercial & Residential Roofing Sales Representative** who can sell roof replacements, quote repairs, and build lasting customer relationships. **Leads are provided for both commercial and residential roofing.** You bring the roofing knowledge, organization, initiative, and closing ability to turn those opportunities into business.

You’ll work with homeowners, property managers, building owners, landlords, and HOAs, managing opportunities from the first appointment through signed contracts and a thorough handoff to production.

**Exceptional follow-up is a must—especially on commercial proposals.** We need someone who takes ownership after an estimate is sent, stays engaged with decision-makers, and keeps every opportunity moving forward.

What You’ll Do

* **Sell residential and commercial roofing:** Roof replacements, reroofing, repairs, and commercial service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Inspect and assess roofing needs:** Conduct on-site inspections, document conditions with photos and measurements, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* **Quote roof repairs:** Prepare clear, accurate repair estimates for residential and commercial properties, coordinating with production when technical input is needed.
* **Prepare professional proposals:** Clearly explain scope of work, pricing, materials, warranties, and available financing options.
* **Own the follow-up process:** Confirm proposals were received, schedule follow-up conversations, answer questions, address objections, and ask for the sale.
* **Manage commercial sales cycles:** Identify decision-makers, understand budgets and approval timelines, and stay engaged through property manager, ownership, or HOA review.
* **Build recurring business:** Develop commercial maintenance relationships and opportunities for future repairs, replacements, referrals, and additional properties.
* **Manage your pipeline:** Keep CRM records current with inspection notes, proposal status, customer communications, and a scheduled next action for every open opportunity.
* **Work independently:** Organize your appointments, travel, estimates, and follow-up activities while meeting established sales and activity goals.
* **Support a smooth production handoff:** Submit complete contracts, photos, measurements, and scope details so the team can deliver what was sold.
* Generate additional business through referrals, networking, and relationships with local property owners and managers.

Who We’re Looking For

* **At least 2 years of roofing sales experience**, with the ability to handle both residential and commercial opportunities.
* Ability to assess and quote residential and commercial roof repairs—not just full replacements.
* Working knowledge of residential roofing and commercial low-slope roofing systems.
* Familiarity with commercial roofing service and preventative maintenance programs.
* **Outstanding follow-up habits:** Persistent, professional, organized, and reliable.
* Proven ability to manage longer sales cycles and communicate with multiple decision-makers.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and closing skills.
* Comfortable using a CRM, preparing proposals, documenting inspections, and managing a sales pipeline.
* A self-starter who can produce results without daily reminders or constant supervision.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to safely access roofs and conduct inspections following company safety procedures.
* Availability for evening and weekend appointments as needed.
* Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.

What We Offer

* **Company-provided commercial and residential leads.**
* Competitive commission structure with uncapped earning potential.
* Multiple sales opportunities: replacements, repairs, and commercial maintenance.
* Ongoing training, product education, and support from experienced roofing professionals.
* Company-branded apparel, marketing support, and inspection tools.
* A team focused on quality workmanship, customer service, and long-term relationships.
* Growth opportunities as we expand across Southern California

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a brief summary of your residential and commercial roofing experience, including your experience estimating repairs and selling maintenance services.

Send a short introduction email.

* What is your name, and where are you located?
* What experience do you have selling residential and commercial roofing?
* Have you personally quoted roof repairs or sold commercial maintenance programs?
* What is your follow-up process after sending a commercial estimate?
* Why would you be a strong addition to our team?

**If you know roofing, take ownership of your opportunities, and understand that consistent follow-up wins business, we want to hear from you.**

San Francisco, CA | [Days], 20 hours/week | Part-time

**Why This Role Matters**  
Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

**What You’ll Do**  
Working under the direct supervision of Club leadership at the Excelsior Clubhouse and San Francisco Community School Club, the Youth Development Coordinator, Floater provides flexible program and departmental support across both locations. This role leads and assists with drop-in activities, tutoring, and structured programs for youth ages 6 to 18, while supporting Club Supervisors and Directors with administrative needs such as daily data entry.

* Engage and facilitate programs — Run games, drop-in activities, homework help, and age-appropriate educational activities that foster creativity and active exploration.
* Promote member success — Communicate the importance of academic success, high school graduation, and post-secondary planning (college, vocational training, or workforce entry).
* Maintain safety and confidentiality — Safeguard member safety and maintain confidentiality at all times across all Club sites.
* Support administrative tracking — Support Club sites in taking daily program attendance and inputting reporting data as assigned.
* Collaborate with tutors and volunteers — Work alongside volunteer tutors and students to participate in ongoing educational improvement programs.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Previous work or volunteer experience (e.g., customer service, education, security, community programs)
* Passion for working with youth ages 6 to 18
* Demonstrated communication, organizational, and self-starter abilities
* Desire to co-facilitate and support teammates in program execution

**Preferred**

* Education or coursework in Early Childhood Development, Education, or a related field
* One or more years of experience in a youth development setting
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days)
* Bilingual in Spanish, Cantonese, or Mandarin
* Active driver’s license

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

**Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive health benefits, including employer contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Education assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Paid Holidays
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Free all-location West Coast Bay Club membership (for FT & PT after 90 days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan: Pre-tax savings program with a discretionary employer contribution for eligible employees after completing one year of service.

**Compensation**  
The wage range for this position is $23.50 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or senior level of the range, depending on qualifications and position requirements.

**Pre-Employment Requirements**  
As part of the hiring process, BGCSF requires candidates to complete LiveScan fingerprinting, a background check, and a tuberculosis (TB) evaluation or test.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
new_jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS), the Executive Assistant to the CEO is the senior administrative partner to the Chief Executive Officer and the Chief of Staff. This role owns the systems, workflows, and standards that govern how the Office of the CEO is accessed and operates. You will exercise delegated authority over the CEO's time, access, and administrative commitments. It sets priorities, resolves scheduling conflicts, and acts on behalf of the CEO and Chief of Staff on matters that do not require their direct involvement. It manages the administrative operations of the executive office end to end. This includes forward planning of the CEO's calendar around Governing Board and organizational cycles. Additionally, it involves preparation and quality control of executive and Board materials. Furthermore, it coordinates executive-level meetings and events. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary contact for the Office of the CEO with staff, Governing Board members, and external parties, and handles confidential and sensitive matters. You will be the resource on executive support practice across the organization, setting the standards that administrative staff follow when working with the CEO's office.

This is a hybrid position, based in our Downtown San Francisco office. Please note that while SFHP supports a hybrid work environment, you are required to be onsite and in-office a minimum of 4 days per month. Beginning in early 2027, the minimum onsite requirement is expected to increase to 8 days per month.

Salary: $100,000 - $120,000 per year

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Manage the CEO and Chief of Staff calendars with delegated authority to accept, decline, reschedule, and prioritize requests for their time, resolving conflicts based on organizational priorities and standing direction.
* Design the annual CEO calendar structure around Governing Board cycles, strategic planning milestones, compliance deadlines, and recurring organizational commitments, and plan forward to protect time for priority work.
* Screen visitors, calls, correspondence, and meeting requests directed to the CEO, resolving administrative and scheduling matters within delegated authority and routing substantive matters to the Chief of Staff or the accountable executive.
* Be the primary contact for the Office of the CEO, responding to inquiries that require an understanding of SFHP operations, procedures, and priorities, and ensuring professional follow-up.
* Make high-level sensitive contacts inside and outside the organization on behalf of the CEO and Chief of Staff.
* Prepare, edit, and quality check correspondence, reports, and presentations for the CEO and Chief of Staff to a publication-ready standard.
* Assemble briefing packets, pre-read materials, and background files for CEO meetings and engagements, obtaining inputs from departments and resolving gaps before deadlines.
* Compile research and background information from internal and public sources at the request of the CEO and Chief of Staff, and summarize findings for their review.
* Coordinate Governing Board meeting logistics, including the materials production timeline, packet assembly, member communications, and meeting-day support and hospitality, and serve as a regular point of contact for Governing Board members.
* Plan and coordinate executive-level meetings, offsites, conferences, and events, including agendas, materials, vendors, space, and technology.
* Coordinate meetings involving multiple stakeholders and Executive Team presence in partnership with department administrative staff and external parties.
* Record and distribute minutes for designated executive meetings and track resulting action items through to closure.
* Maintain the commitment and follow-up tracking system for the Office of the CEO, monitoring due dates, prompting assigned owners, and reporting outstanding items to the CEO and Chief of Staff.
* Alert the CEO and Chief of Staff to issues requiring immediate attention and follow up on pending matters.
* Manage complex, frequent travel for the CEO and Chief of Staff, anticipating logistical needs and resolving disruptions, and reconcile and process related expense reports.
* Monitor the Office of the CEO administrative budget, track expenditures against plan, and process invoices and expense reimbursements.
* Develop, document, and improve the workflows, templates, filing systems, and tracking tools used to run the Office of the CEO, including records management consistent with public records requirements.

* Minimum seven years of experience performing administrative support tasks for senior or executive-level management, including direct support of a CEO or C-suite executive
* Experience exercising delegated authority over an executive's calendar, correspondence, and commitments in a fast-paced, complex environment
* Experience managing complex scheduling, offsite meetings, and frequent travel for executives
* Experience supporting a governing board, board of directors, or other public body

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

  + Medical: You'll have a choice of medical plans, including options from Kaiser and Blue Shield of California, heavily subsidized by SFHP.

**What You'll Bring**

**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.

**About Georgia Tech**

Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.

2. We strive for excellence.

3. We thrive on diversity.

4. We celebrate collaboration.

5. We champion innovation.

6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.

7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.

8. We act ethically.

9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

The Campus Recreation Complex (CRC) is a 300,659 sq. ft. facility located on the West side of campus. The complex is a unique expansion of the existing swimming and diving venue built for the 1996 Olympic Games. Campus Recreation provides a premier recreation fitness center, aquatic center, recreation fields, and leadership challenge course for the Georgia Tech community. We offer programming that includes Intramural Sports, Club Sports, Fitness Instruction and Classes, and Outdoor Recreation.

**Job Summary**
---------------

  

The Challenge and Climbing Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating programs and operations at the Leadership Challenge Complex (LCC) and indoor rock-climbing facility, while also supporting the planning and execution of large-scale outdoor recreation trips, expeditions, and experiential learning opportunities. This role leads outreach initiatives to promote programs across campus and to external organizations, fostering engagement and increasing participation. Through these experiences, the Coordinator helps enhance the student experience while providing campus constituents and community partners with meaningful opportunities to develop leadership, teamwork, and outdoor recreation skills.
  
  
Typically, will interact consistently with: Students, Staff, Faculty
  
  
Typically, will advise and counsel: Staff, Students, External Stakeholders
  
  
This position will supervise: Students
  
  
Position of Trust: Yes

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

By advancing professional development, fostering collaboration, and aligning with our strategic vision, you will help ensure that state public servants are prepared to serve with excellence. If you are a detail-oriented leader who drives processes, ensures results, and delivers lasting impact, we want you on our team.

**WHO WE ARE**

The Southern Office of The Council of State Governments (CSG South) empowers and elevates public servants across the 15 Southern states. Through policy innovation, leadership development, and regional collaboration, we equip leaders to serve their constituents with excellence. We live out our core values in all that we do:

* **Servant's Heart** – We lead by serving others.
* **Ambitious** – We set bold goals and pursue them relentlessly.
* **Adaptable** – We respond to challenges with innovation and agility.
* **Accountable** – We honor commitments, our policies, and own our outcomes.
* **Credible** – We earn trust through excellence and integrity.

1BPOSITION SUMMARY

The Executive Assistant provides administrative support to the Regional Director and coordinates activities that keep CSG South's executive office organized, responsive, and effective. This position manages executive scheduling, travel, correspondence, and meeting preparations; supports governance activities and engagement with state leaders; and coordinates committee appointments, member communications, and state visit logistics. The role also manages day-to-day office and facilities administration, including vendor coordination, supplies, and inventory, and provides designated support for the Southern Legislative Conference. Success requires sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and proactive follow-through, with a commitment to professional service and CSG South's nonpartisan mission. This role will report to the Regional Director with guidance and supervision from the Strategic Operations Manager.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

**Executive Administration and Coordination:**

* Proactively manage the Regional Director's calendar, meeting priorities, correspondence, scheduling conflicts, and related executive workflows.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, detailed itineraries, meeting logistics, receipts, and expense documentation for the Regional Director.
* Screen, prioritize, and coordinate executive communications and requests, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and timely follow-through.
* Coordinate internal leadership meeting materials and schedules for the Regional Director, including L10 Meetings, skip meetings, Directors Retreat, monthly staff meetings, etc.
* Assist with booking reservations, coordinating meals, and other logistics for internal staff meetings and trainings.
* Anticipate emerging scheduling, administrative, and operational needs and coordinate solutions with the Regional Director, Strategic Operations Manager, and appropriate colleagues.
* Coordinate and schedule REAL|STATE podcast interviews with elected officials and state leaders, with guidance from the Regional Director and Strategic Operations Manager, ensuring calendar invitations, directives, and planning are informative and accurate.
* Maintain organized, confidential executive records, contact information, and documentation in accordance with organizational practices.

**Governance, State Leadership, and Member Engagement:**

* Coordinate Executive Committee communications, meeting preparations, briefing packets, travel arrangements, and follow-up with assistance and direction from the Regional Director and Strategic Operations Manager for annual, virtual, and other designated governance meetings.
* Coordinate communications and logistics, with guidance from the Strategic Operations Manager and the Regional Director, involving the Chair, Chair-Elect, Executive Committee members, elected officials, senior government staff, and other organizational principals.
* Coordinate and implement the administrative actions of securing legislative and staff policy committee appointments and Chair Scholarships from appointing authorities, including correspondence, tracking, notifications, welcome materials, and coordination with departments.
* Coordinate and implement member mailings, including new member, new leader, and committee packets.
* Manage the logistics for state visits for the policy and program team, including assisting the Director of Strategic Partnerships and Policy in determining dates, booking hotel rooms, planning for state receptions during state visits, and determining flights.
* Coordinate scheduling and briefing materials for Regional Director state visits, leadership meetings, and designated convenings; track responses and post-visit follow-up.
* Maintain current leadership rosters and key contact information needed for executive communications, coordinating updates with staff responsible for organizational contact systems.
* Provide executive-level administrative support for selected funder recognition and partnership meetings, in coordination with the appropriate department leadership.

Backed by world-class research and continued innovation, we create mattresses with adjustable firmness, pressure relief, and temperature-balancing comfort that adapt to customers’ changing needs, night after night, year after year. Our people thrive in a culture where purpose, innovation, and customer experience drive every decision. Join us and help shape the future of sleep wellness.

**Make an Impact**

At Sleep Number, we improve lives by personalizing sleep. Join a team driven by curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for helping others thrive—one restful night at a time.

Our Sales Representatives are high-impact roles that directly contribute to our purpose. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your retail sales career and experience unlimited earning potential.

**What Sets You Up for Success**

* You’re energetic, proactive, and thrive in a customer-focused environment.
* You’re a collaborative team player who welcomes feedback and coaching.

**What You’ll Get**
